messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting Spearhead LoRA merge onboarding. Pushing a quick eval pack to the shared bucket: gs://redwood-evals/spearhead/preflight_v1.tar.gz. Primary ask: compatibility check with their tokenizer and int4 quantization behavior. Thoughts?

devon: Nice. Do we have their tokenizer mapping? last time mapping->token-id shift caused hallucinations.

akash: They sent a token_map.json in the customer zip. I pulled and ran a small tagger test. Some special tokens map to different ids; will attach diff.

eva: Can you paste the command you ran? I'll run our 4-bit smoke with the same prompts.

maria: Command I used:
```
./eval/run_quickpack.sh --model gpt-base+SpearheadLoRA --quant int4 --prompts smoke_prompts.json --token-map ./token_map.json
```
Results: perplexity up ~2% vs baseline, but numeric amounts get munged in a handful of cases.

ci-bot: CI: eval-suite/spearhead-preflight started by maria (job 6721).

devon: :thinking_face: Can you drop a diff of outputs where numbers change?

akash: Diff: `diff outputs/baseline.out outputs/lora.out | head -n 30` — key example: 'Invoice total $1,200.00' -> '$1200.0' (formatting) and one case 'Order #0042' -> 'Order 42' lost zero padding.

eva: Formatting break is probably tokenization + quant rounding. Suggest adding token remap to preserve leading zeros for order ids. Also run with KV-cache warmstart to ensure it isn't a generation artifact.

maria: Good call. I'll add token remap and re-run with warmstart. Also want to validate canary routing: if we bake SpearheadLoRA into canary, we should set fallback to base model.

devon: Agree. For canary config here's a quick snippet:
```
route: canary
model: gpt-base+SpearheadLoRA
fallback: gpt-base
slo: latency<250ms
percent: 5
```
Keep percent low until we confirm behavioral regressions.

eva: Running warmstart int4 now. I'll post logs shortly.

ci-bot: CI: eval-suite/spearhead-preflight job 6721 failed on smoke check (1/48 tests regressed). See logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/6721/logs

maria: :exclamation: Which test?

ci-bot: Regressed test: invoices/amount-format.json (test id 12).

akash: Known regression. I patched token remap locally and re-ran — passes. PR coming: 'fix/spearhead-token-remap'

devon: Once PR is up ping me and I can coordinate a small bake.

maria: Thanks — ping when CI passes. If we get green, I'll schedule a 5% canary rollout with fallback to base. Also we should add a targeted eval monitoring rule for 'numeric-format' alerts.

eva: Added alert: evalmon.rule -> 'numeric-format' with threshold 0.5% regressions. Will monitor.

maria: Perfect. Closing the loop: next steps: akash PR + ci green, eva warms runs + canary config ready, devon will monitor rollout. :thumbsup:
